verdict.rationale: Raygun ships a built-in AI Error Resolution chat inside Crash Reporting. It auto-prompts an LLM with stack trace and code context, suggests root causes and fixes, supports collaborative chat with teammates, and can post a link to the conversation as a comment. However, it is advisory rather than a true task-delegation agent: it suggests fixes but is not documented to act on your behalf. It also requires you to supply your own OpenAI API key. Missing for 10: evidence the assistant can execute or delegate actions (e.g., resolving or ignoring errors, creating issues, triaging), scope beyond error-fix suggestions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
